name: Alexander Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Alexander Valley wines are known for a rich, fleshy, voluptuous feel from the warm climate.
Its Cabernet Sauvignon often shows chocolate notes and a warm mouthfeel.
Its Chardonnay is rich, with tropical fruit.
Merlot here tends to show plum, tea leaf and black cherry.

blurb.text: A valley appellation in northeastern Sonoma County, just north of Healdsburg, within the North Coast and Northern Sonoma. The Pine Mountain-Cloverdale Peak AVA overlaps its northern tip.
